title: ADDRESS COMMAREA and ADDRESS EIB with SET ADDRESS OF: the callee's pointer is the caller's storage, no COMMAREA gives X'FF000000', the EIB view is the EIB

scenarios.summary: LINK with COMMAREA(WS-AREA) LENGTH(20): the callee's ADDRESS COMMAREA pointer sees the caller's bytes and its write through SET ADDRESS OF lands in the caller's area
EIBCALEN 0, in the terminal task and in a callee LINKed without COMMAREA: ADDRESS COMMAREA gives the null value X'FF000000'
ADDRESS EIB then SET ADDRESS OF a view: its fields equal the DFHEIBLK fields
